notes.content: The VR HUD height/distance is now adjustable in the settings

[list]
[*]Fixed chests de spawning when they are not empty
[*]Expanded the hub to include a much larger Town area that you can enter near the meat shop (Town doesn't have Multiplayer yet)
[/list]

The Market Hub where you shop now has public multiplayer up to 16 players
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37718685/480375a4594a0a478726bfc046e78fe4976d885e.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Fixed late joining players don't enter boss arena in Dungeon/Caves
[*]Fixed unable to abandon Tutorial
[*]Fix equipment attributes not loading in certain maps (Such as losing all resistances when entering Thunder Cobra)
[*]Fixed unable to interact with In-Game menus if you fail and abandon at the same time
[*]Fixed Ice Cave entrance is the wrong color
[*]Fixed Root/Freeze not snapping to ground if you aim too high
[/list]

[list]
[*]Added VR setting for toggle sprint, smooth turning, turn angle, and haptics
[*]Added haptic feedback to weapon swing/hit, shield block, ranged weapon fire, spell cast
[*]Fixed unable to enter Spider King boss arena
[*]Fixed quest window overlaps part of keyboard
[*]Fixed crossbow fires in menu after dodging in menu
[*]Fixed bow/crossbow randomly firing
[*]Fixed jump progress stuck on screen if you failed to jump (Such as out of stamina)
[*]Fixed able to walk off Spider King Arena without falling
[/list]

[list]
[*]Fixed enemies de-spawning after entering SteamVR menu by preventing pausing
[*]Fixed stuck loading due to dying during loading
[*]Fixed VR Chat Keyboard remains open after closing Inventory
[*]Fixed unable to use VR Chat Keyboard after sending a message
[*]Fixed able to leave Dungeon Boss Arena (Exploit)
[*]Removed casting with joystick/touch-pad down
[*]Removed fade to black and rewind when head enters collider
[*]Prevented walking through [i]most[/i] walls 
[/list]
